title: Law to require speed-limiting devices for repeat speeders
summary: This bill would require owners of vehicles found liable for 16 or more school-zone speeding violations within 12 months to install and maintain intelligent speed assistance devices that limit vehicle speed, with manual override allowed in emergencies. The mandatory installation period would start at 12 months and increase for repeat offenders, and owners generally bear the cost unless they qualify as low-income. The law would take effect May 26, 2027 and requires a report to the Council on the program's results.
